description: The second printf in the middle of main lacks its closing double quote, and more statements follow it.
injected_faults: line 8: string literal "Cost: %d\n opened but never closed before the end of the line
notes: Expected under plan 002: raw 2. LEX-UNTERMINATED-STRING 8 (caused_by: none), SYN-EXPECTED-EXPRESSION 9 (caused_by: R1). 'printf(' is left without an argument, so the parser finds 'if' on line 9 (lex_gap set, R1). Panic stops at once before 'if', which is parsed normally; 'cost' is still read on later lines. gcc: missing terminating " character, then expected ')' before 'if'.
